reviews.review_title: Garbage Beat Saber Mimic Cash Grab
reviews.review_description: The title says it all. Stay away, unless you think the internet radio aspect is worth it. (spoiler: it's not) Don't believe the other reviews (from friends of the devs) that state that you can play infinitely. I was allowed to play one station on one difficulty level. Paywalls for anything beyond that.
I love that you can just keep going and the menu and settings are managble from your controllers. No stopping and figuring anything out AND its free. Heck yeah
